name: Azulongmon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the hand. Then, unsuspend 1 of your Digimon with the [Deva], [Four Great Dragons] or [Four Sovereigns] trait.
[On Deletion] Delete 1 of your opponent's highest level Digimon.
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
